occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.rationale: These managers would use Klaviyo to give their marketing teams the autonomy to launch sophisticated omnichannel campaigns across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, and web, as mentioned in excerpt D:Klaviyo:landing:6.

occupations.title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
occupations.rationale: These specialists would directly use the platform's AI marketing agent to audit flows, manage segments, and create entire on-brand campaigns to maximize revenue, as described in excerpt D:Klaviyo:landing:2.

occupations.title: Online Merchants
occupations.rationale: Online merchants would use this product as it is a B2C CRM that offers native integrations with ecommerce platforms like Shopify to run personalized marketing campaigns, as stated in excerpts D:Klaviyo:landing:1 and D:Klaviyo:landing:5.
